tasks.label: Kill SSH/Git
tasks.command: taskkill /F /IM ssh.exe 2>nul & taskkill /F /IM git.exe 2>nul & echo done

tasks.label: clean-ssh
args: taskkill /F /IM ssh.exe 2>nul & taskkill /F /IM git.exe 2>nul & echo cleaned

tasks.label: build-dev-image
tasks.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location 'd:\pallastrade\spree'; docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build 2>&1"
